title_text: NATZEE ZOMBIE CARNAGE Blitzkrieg Der Untoten Übermensch
credits_text: WEED FILMS, in association with BORED NERDS PRODUCTION, presents a "WWW Zombie Horror B Movie"
other_text: During WWII, in the Winter of 1944, American Soldiers force the battle against an Axis Powers offensive of Nazi Zombie Atomic Super Soldiers, during the "Battle of the Bulge". The Nazi forces use black magic, to resurrect dead German soldiers, and wipe out the Sun from the sky. Once the Sun is gone, all crops will fail, all livestock will die, Europe will be without the Sun, and these new undead super-soldiers will fight all over next thousand years to control the continents.
moderation_notes: Contains implied violent themes and weapon imagery.
description: Poster shows soldiers in military uniforms holding rifles, with bold title text and tagline describing a zombie horror scenario during WWII.
